integrity: Two independent standalone exact checkers reconstruct all graph edges and the full finite resolving and reconfiguration spaces. Theorems have not undergone independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: A fixed twelve-vertex finite graph only; no assertion for other Platonic graphs or a general family. Finite exhaustive checkers are reproducible; publication-priority search cannot exclude unindexed independent work.
title: Antipodal completion and the sharp two-spare mixed-resolution threshold of the icosahedron
